🔎 Live search the whole Okanagan (beta), pulls fresh results directly from Google ▾

This queries Google Places directly, so it can find venues beyond the curated list above, but results here show name, address, and rating only. Amenities (dog/vegan/kid/patio/GF) aren't verified for live results, so nothing gets auto-added to the directory. You'll need your own Google Places API key with billing enabled, get one at Google Cloud Console (enable the "Places API (New)"). Your key is stored only in your browser, never sent anywhere but Google.

Pins mark each town/area center, not individual addresses, click a pin to see what's currently filtered there, then use "Get directions" on any venue for its exact location.

Places you'll love

812 places to explore

Every place below is a real Okanagan venue, pulled from live Google Places data and cross-checked against reviews for dog, patio, vegan, kid, and gluten-free signals (only flagged when a review said so, not guessed). Covers the Central, South, and North Okanagan plus Big White, SilverStar, Apex, and Mount Baldy. It's not every venue in the valley (200+ wineries alone). Amenities change seasonally, happy hour times aren't confirmed yet so that filter won't return results, and price level ($/$$/$$$) is still being added venue by venue. Double check before you go.
